notes: Downstage 1.3.1: no more keychain prompt at startup — the system keychain is used only when an assistant key is saved or a request runs. From 1.3: a mixing assistant in the inspector (AI tab, ⌘J) that measures every channel and a minute of the mix, reads the console and answers with a plan of moves you look over and apply as one undo step, on Claude, GPT, Gemini or any OpenAI-compatible service or local server with your own API key; new sessions start with no channels, built-in templates bring 8, 16, 24, 32 or 48 tracks, every track can be deleted; an input monitor switch (I) next to R on every track in the Edit window.
